subject: gk
question: How many candidates will be trained under the third phase of the Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana, which was launched in January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**8 lakh**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The government **had launched the third phase of **Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 3.0) on 15th January 2021**.

 
 
• It is to train **8.00 lakh youths across the country including North Eastern Region.**
 
 
 
• It had an **outlay of ****₹948.90 crores.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **About Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana:**

 
 
• **​Established on: **2015
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)** is the** flagship scheme of the Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship (MSDE).**
 
• **Implemented by National Skill Development Corporation.**
 
• The objective of this Skill Certification Scheme is to
 
 
• **Enable a large number of Indian youth** to take up industry-relevant skill training that will** help them in securing a better livelihood.**
 
• Individuals with prior learning experience or skills will also be assessed and certified under **Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL).**
